wish_topics.evidence_span: Transitioning to a completely sustainable energy supply that does not rely on fossil fuels
Reducing global poverty and developing a global economic model that prioritizes equitable wealth distribution
Eliminating the financial barriers to healthcare worldwide, ensuring universal healthcare access
Implementing education systems that encourage critical thinking, innovation, and sustainability
Developing a global conflict resolution system that focuses on genuine reconciliation rather than punitive measures
Implementing robust international privacy laws to protect individuals' data from corporate exploitation
